adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, when a calendar reference has a `credentialId` but the credential is not found in `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`, the new fallback does `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` and then assigns `calendarCredential = foundCalendarCredential` (raw Prisma `Credential`) before calling `getCalendar(calendarCredential)`. Unlike the analogous new DB-fetch logic added in `EventManager.ts`, this fetch does not `include: { app: { select: { slug: true }}}` nor does it reconstruct a `{ appName: app.slug, ... }` object. Given this diff also changes the core calendar flow to rely on `CredentialWithAppName` (e.g., `CalendarManager.createEvent(credential: CredentialWithAppName, ...)` and `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent(..., credentialId)`), passing a raw credential without `appName` can plausibly prevent `getCalendar` from resolving the correct calendar service, leaving some referenced events undeleted. This path is now more reachable because cancellations now iterate over *all* `_calendar` references (collective/multi-host).
